title: SmartLess Presents ClueLess! 137 - Word Workout (w/ Jeff Max)

sentences.en: Hey, Smarties, it's Sean Hayes here.
sentences.zh: 嘿，各位“机灵鬼”，我是肖恩·海斯。

sentences.en: You may remember that we launched a new bite-sized game show last year called Clueless.
sentences.zh: 大家可能还记得，我们去年推出了一档全新的迷你游戏秀，叫《一窍不通》。

sentences.en: In every episode, our hilarious host, Elliot Kalin, takes me and a friend of mine through
sentences.zh: 在每一集里，我们幽默风趣的主持人埃利奥特·卡林会带着我和我的一个朋友

sentences.en: a different game, and sometimes they're word puzzles or chains of common phrases, or robots
sentences.zh: 玩不同的游戏，有时是字谜、常用短语接龙，或是机器人

sentences.en: singing songs, we have to guess.
It's a whole lot of fun.
Here's an episode that came out today with my good friend, actor and comedian Jeff Max,
sentences.zh: 今天给大家带来的是我好朋友、演员兼喜剧演员杰夫·马克斯的一集节目，

sentences.en: where we play one of our favorite new games, Word Workout.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中玩了我们最喜欢的全新游戏之一——“单词健身”。

sentences.en: Check out Smartless Presents Clueless anywhere you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 大家可以在任何收听播客的地方搜索收听《Smartless Presents Clueless》。

sentences.en: New episodes every Monday and Thursday.
I'd like to open this episode with a quick financial update.
sentences.zh: 我想以一条简短的财务快讯来开启这一集。

sentences.en: Due to inflation, a bird in the hand is now worth four in the bush.
sentences.zh: 由于通货膨胀，一鸟在手现在相当于林中四鸟了。
请大家相应地调整你们的谚语。

sentences.en: Welcome to Smartless Presents Clueless, the only puzzle podcast, period.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《Smartless Presents Clueless》，这是唯一的解谜播客，没有之一。

sentences.en: I refuse to recognize any others.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝承认其他任何同类播客。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Elliot Kalin, and I come from the future with a warning for all mankind.
sentences.zh: 我是你们的主持人埃利奥特·卡林，我来自未来，给全人类带了一个警告。

sentences.en: But first, please welcome the man who's got entertainment in his blood, but don't worry,
sentences.zh: 但首先，请欢迎这位血液里流淌着娱乐精神的男士，不过别担心，

sentences.en: Yeah, I can't get off it.
Today, we are joined by an old friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们迎来了一位我的老朋友。

sentences.en: We grew up in the theater together.
If you heard the previous episode, you would know what I'm talking about.
sentences.zh: 如果你听过上一集，你就会知道我在说什么。

sentences.en: He needs a little slapping around sometimes because we've got to keep him real.
sentences.zh: 有时得抽他两下，因为我们得让他认清现实。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, it's Jeff or Jeffrey, depending on how gay he is that day, Max.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，这位是杰夫，或者叫杰弗里，取决于他那天有多“弯”，马克斯。

sentences.en: And he's going to sing a little something for us.
I love you for headlifters and ball barrels.
sentences.zh: 我爱你，为了那些抬头族和球桶。

sentences.en: That was a very little something.
They say patience is a virtue, but having too much patience is just being lazy.
sentences.zh: 人们常说耐心是一种美德，但耐心过头就是懒惰。

sentences.en: So let's stop waiting around and reveal the answer to last episode's cliffhanger puzzle,
sentences.zh: 所以我们别干等了，来揭晓上一集悬念谜题的答案吧，

sentences.en: You may remember it was an odd one out that went thusly.
sentences.zh: 大家可能还记得，那是一个这样的找不同谜题。

sentences.en: Drove, never, murder, school, or unkindness?
sentences.zh: Drove（车队/驾驶）、never（从不）、murder（乌鸦群/谋杀）、school（鱼群/学校），还是unkindness（不友善/乌鸦群）？

sentences.en: I mean, well, the first thing, Jeff, I was thinking was there's like a group of crows can be a murder.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，杰夫，我首先想到的是，比如有一群乌鸦可以叫 murder。

sentences.en: A group of fish can be a school.
But am I on the right track?
You are very much on the right track, yes.
sentences.zh: 你的方向完全正确，是的。

sentences.en: Because you have a drove of something.
sentences.zh: 因为你有一个什么东西的“群”。

sentences.en: You do have a drove of something.
sentences.zh: 你确实有一个什么东西的“群”。

sentences.en: But an unkindness, I don't know what that is.
sentences.zh: 但“恶毒”（unkindness），我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: I don't know like a group of animals that's a never.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有什么动物的群叫“绝不”。

sentences.en: But I don't know a group of animals that's an unkindness.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道有什么动物群叫“恶毒”。

sentences.en: But that does sound like one.
sentences.zh: 但听起来确实像那么回事。

sentences.en: I'm just going to go for it.
Here's what I love about what you did.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢你刚才的举动是这样的。

sentences.en: This is classic professional puzzle playing.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是专业解谜玩家的经典操作。

sentences.en: You're like, I have a sense of it.
sentences.zh: 你心里想，我大概有感觉了。

sentences.en: I know what some of these things are.
sentences.zh: 我知道其中一些是什么意思。

sentences.en: I'm using my logic to narrow it down to two.
sentences.zh: 我用逻辑把范围缩小到两个。

sentences.en: And then at the last two, you're like, I don't know which one.
sentences.zh: 然后到了最后两个，你会想，我不知道选哪个。

sentences.en: So I'm going to take a gamble.
Because every game player at heart is a gambler.
sentences.zh: 因为每个玩家骨子里都是个赌徒。

sentences.en: I would have never known there's a group of animals called a murder.
sentences.zh: 我以前绝对不知道原来有一群动物叫作“谋杀”（murder）。

sentences.en: I've never heard of that before.
And it's an unkindness of ravens.
sentences.zh: 而一群渡鸦叫 unkindness（恶毒）。

sentences.en: Unkindness is ravens, which is very close to crows.
sentences.zh: Unkindness 是渡鸦，这和乌鸦非常接近。
而 never 什么都不是。

sentences.en: A really of Jeff's, I guess, is the...
sentences.zh: 杰夫的“真的”（a really），我猜就是...
这就是我们一直以来所欠缺的。

sentences.en: We've never had a guest with a catchphrase before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前从来没有请过自带口头禅的嘉宾。

sentences.en: And I'm very excited about that.
And by the way, a catchphrase that caught on in literally 10 seconds.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这个口头禅 буквально 真的在10秒钟内就火了。

sentences.en: Well, you also have to follow it up with, I never knew.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你还得接上一句，我以前可不知道。

sentences.en: Also, get a couple of drinks in them and that, oh, really?
sentences.zh: 而且，让他们喝上几杯之后，那句“哦，真的吗？”

sentences.en: Thank you to Monopoly for supporting today's episode.
sentences.zh: 感谢《大富翁》对本期节目的赞助。

sentences.en: Clueless listeners, Monopoly has created three new ways to play with expansions you add on
sentences.zh: 各位听众，《大富翁》推出了三种全新的玩法，你可以将扩展包添加到
你经典的《大富翁》套装中。

sentences.en: If you want to own the whole board, the Buy Everything expansion lets you do just that.
sentences.zh: 如果你想拥有整个棋盘，“全盘买下”扩展包就能让你如愿以偿。

sentences.en: Every space on the board is up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 棋盘上的每一个格子都可以抢购。

sentences.en: And with the Buy Die, you get even more ways to win faSt.
sentences.zh: 有了购买骰子，你将获得更多快速获胜的方法。

sentences.en: If you're the kind of person who likes to press their luck, like Elliot,
sentences.zh: 如果你是那种喜欢碰运气的人，比如埃利奥特，

sentences.en: the free parking jackpot expansion is your jam.
sentences.zh: “免费停车大奖”扩展包就是你的菜。

sentences.en: Land on free parking, spin the wheel, and boom, cash in big.
sentences.zh: 停在免费停车格上，转动转盘，然后轰的一声，赚大钱。

sentences.en: But don't get too comfortable because it's risky.
sentences.zh: 但别太得意忘形，因为这有风险。

sentences.en: One spin could have you rolling in money or losing it all.
sentences.zh: 转一次盘可能让你财源滚滚，也可能让你输个精光。

sentences.en: It's high stakes, fast, and definitely for the competitive players.
sentences.zh: 这刺激、节奏快，绝对适合好胜的玩家。

sentences.en: And if you're a mastermind who loves little chaos, like Sean,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个喜欢一点小混乱的智囊，比如肖恩，

sentences.en: the go-to-jail expansion is a game changer.
sentences.zh: “进监狱”扩展包将彻底改变游戏规则。

sentences.en: Kick, bribe, steal, and collect corruption cards to mess with your opponents.
sentences.zh: 踢人、行贿、偷窃，还要收集腐败卡来整你的对手。

sentences.en: Turns out, crime does pay, at least in Monopoly.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，犯罪确实有回报，至少在《大富翁》里是这样。

sentences.en: So whether you're a risk taker, rule breaker, or moneymaker,
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你是冒险家、破局者还是赚钱高手，

sentences.en: Monopoly has three new expansion packs for you to explore.
sentences.zh: 《大富翁》都有三款全新的扩展包等你探索。

sentences.en: Pick your pack or grab all three and let the game get a whole lot more exciting.
sentences.zh: 挑选你的扩展包或将三个全部收入囊中，让游戏变得更加刺激。

sentences.en: All is fair in Monopoly expansions.
sentences.zh: 在《大富翁》扩展包的世界里，一切都是公平的。

sentences.en: Monopoly is a trademark of Hasbro.
Listeners at home, did you get the answer?
sentences.zh: 电视机前的听众朋友们，你们猜出答案了吗？

sentences.en: Postmodern theory tells us all truth is relative.
sentences.zh: 后现代主义理论告诉我们，所有的真理都是相对的。

sentences.en: But let's pretend there's such a thing as objective reality for just a couple more minutes
sentences.zh: 但让我们再假装几分钟存在客观现实这种东西，

sentences.en: so we can play today's main game.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能玩今天的重头游戏了。
这个节目叫做《单词健身》。

sentences.en: I can't wait for the album to come out.
Now, okay, we've got seven words for you.
sentences.zh: 好啦，现在我们准备了七个单词给你。

sentences.en: Each of them wants to slim down and lose some weight,
sentences.zh: 它们每个都想瘦身减肥，

sentences.en: and we're going to help get them into shape.
sentences.zh: 而我们要帮它们恢复体形。

sentences.en: For each clue, I'm going to give you the starting word
sentences.zh: 每个线索，我会给你一个起始词，

sentences.en: and then ask you to remove one letter
sentences.zh: 然后要求你去掉一个字母，

sentences.en: and then rearrange the remaining letters to create a new spilter.
sentences.zh: 再重新排列剩下的字母来创造一个新的拼写。

sentences.en: If the clue was remove a letter from cinema
sentences.zh: 如果线索是从"cinema"（电影院）中去掉一个字母

sentences.en: to get a type of Japanese animation,
You take out the C, rearrange them, you get anime.
sentences.zh: 你去掉C，重新排列，就得到了anime（动漫）。

sentences.en: Are you ready to send these words to the gym?
sentences.zh: 准备好把这些单词送去健身房了吗？

sentences.en: Let's start with question number one.

sentences.zh: 从"candle"（蜡烛）中去掉一个字母

sentences.en: to get a series of rhythmic movements.
sentences.zh: 来得到一系列有节奏的动作。

sentences.en: Damn, I would have never gotten that.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我绝对猜不到这个。

sentences.en: Tell me, which letter did you remove out of there?
sentences.zh: 告诉我，你从中去掉了哪个字母？

sentences.en: I remove, well, if you speak the English language,
sentences.zh: 我去掉的，嗯，如果你说英语的话，

sentences.zh: 从"basket"（篮子）中去掉一个字母来得到上等肉块。

sentences.en: Oh, I was going to say brisket.
But wait, to get a prime cut.
sentences.zh: 但等等，要得到上等肉块。

sentences.en: Take a look at those letters
and see which ones you might be able to rearrange to me.
sentences.zh: 想想你可以重新排列哪几个。

sentences.en: which is the part of the cow you don't use anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正这部分牛身上也是用不到的。

sentences.en: And you just get the steak.
sentences.zh: 然后你就直接得到了牛排。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going to go ahead
and put the L from candle in steak.
sentences.zh: 把 candle 里的 L 放进 steak 里。
从 course 中去掉一个字母，
这里的 course 是指粗糙的。

sentences.en: Remove a letter from course to get the sports results.
sentences.zh: 从 course 中去掉一个字母来得到体育比赛结果。

sentences.en: You remove the A and you get score.
sentences.zh: 去掉 A 你就得到了比分。
从 cereal 中去掉一个字母，

sentences.en: as in things in order, S-E-R-I-A-L,
sentences.zh: 也就是表示顺序的那个词，S-E-R-I-A-L，
来得到一些长长的轨道。

sentences.en: I was hoping you would also say long tracks, Jack.
sentences.zh: 我本来希望你也会说长轨道，杰克。

sentences.en: You remove the E and you get rails.
sentences.zh: 去掉 E 你就得到了铁轨。

sentences.en: I think I said that with you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我跟你一起说出来了。
从 barber 中去掉一个字母

sentences.en: to get a kind of fitness activity.

sentences.zh: 从 barber 中去掉一个字母

sentences.en: to get a kind of fitness activity.
Barber the elephant is a different story.
sentences.zh: 大象理发师巴伯则是另一回事。

sentences.en: He holds the scissors in his trunk.
Would you like a hint or a clue?
sentences.zh: 你想听个提示还是线索？

sentences.zh: 提示是，这是一项以芭蕾为基础的健身活动。

sentences.zh: 如果你想要线索，我来告诉你该去掉哪个字母。
这是一个与芭蕾相关的活动。
一项以芭蕾为基础的健身活动。

sentences.en: Yes, you removed the B to get bar.
sentences.zh: 是的，你去掉了B得到了把杆。

sentences.en: But that's a hard one, right?
That was a really hard one.
I hope you walk away from this knowing that you got a really hard one, and it just gives
sentences.zh: 我希望你离开这里时知道自己答对了一个非常难的题目，这能给你

sentences.en: you confidence for whatever you're doing next.
sentences.zh: 接下来的任何事情带来信心。

You just hang out on the bar?
sentences.zh: 你只是在把杆上闲逛吗？

sentences.en: No, when you do bar, you do like a bunch.
sentences.zh: 不，当你练习把杆时，你会做很多动作。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I would think it's more dance-related, and I don't know anybody who goes to the gym
sentences.zh: 是啊，但我觉得这更多是和舞蹈相关的，而且我不认识谁去健身房

sentences.en: Well, they've started doing, it's a, you know, they can turn anything into fitness.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们已经开始做了，你知道的，他们能把任何东西变成健身项目。

sentences.zh: 他们把芭蕾练习变成了健身项目。

sentences.zh: 这就像普拉提（Pilates）以前刚变成健身项目时，大家还以为是盘子（plates）一样。

sentences.zh: 从敲钟人（ringer）中去掉一个字母，以得到君主国的统治期（span of a monarchy）。

sentences.en: And now, finally, our last one for this game.
sentences.zh: 现在，终于到了我们这个游戏的最后一题。

sentences.zh: 从sellout中去掉一个字母，得到一种弄乱别人头发的方法。

sentences.en: That's, I thought that was going to be the hardest of them.
sentences.zh: 那是，我还以为这会是最难的一题呢。

sentences.en: But instead, if anything, it was the easiest of them.
sentences.zh: 但相反，如果说有什么的话，它反而是最简单的一题。

sentences.en: But now that we've sweated off all those unsightly extra letters, we've got to find some
sentences.zh: 但既然我们已经通过出汗去掉了那些难看的、多余的字母，我们就得找个

sentences.zh: 那是一件能买到饮品的健身器材，答案是杠铃（barbell）。

sentences.en: And it's not a bar again?
No, this time it's just the other kind of bar.
Let's not lose our pleasing disposition.
sentences.zh: 咱们别破坏了这愉快的心情。

sentences.en: Well, listeners, did you do as well as Sean and Jeff?
sentences.zh: 好了，听众朋友们，你们表现得和肖恩及杰夫一样好吗？

sentences.en: If so, your steak is free.
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，你们的牛排就免单。

sentences.zh: 但在开吃之前，请务必留点空间来迎接今天的悬念谜题。

sentences.zh: 悬念谜题就像是一个灯神让你许愿能许更多愿望一样，
